query:
SELECT 
  axis_primary_code as axis,
  entry_type as type,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM v3_references
WHERE axis_primary_code IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY axis_primary_code, entry_type
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 30;
